focus: Authority: only the manager can dispatch via to_worker (token role), no other path starts runs; the standing delegation is recorded as such; worker cannot dispatch; tools cannot impersonate the user (pause/resume/kill stay UI-only).

Shared user shell safety: Workbench never types into the user's shell unless verified idle (prompt, partial line, jobs via /proc), user input refused only while held and always returned, cwd restored, C-D58/held handoff escape, job latch adjudication.

Lifecycle: 60 s checks, pause/resume reconciliation, run_closed_while_paused, retry limit, delivery serialization (no two deliveries into one OMP turn), thread safety of the new threads (outbox lanes, tick thread, transition thread), backend shutdown/restart cleanliness.
Records: journals 0600/fsync, no secrets/env values; ui_v1 additive/removal handled per versioning rules; UI rendering robust.
Skills match the tool schemas and C-D66 rules; isolation still holds.
Tests assert behaviour; independent adaptations kept invariants; xfail only for the adjudicated F5.
